span.note: what this limits: the artificial-intelligence component of this proposal: the paper states ChatGPT output is not necessarily coherent and contiguous and that further work is needed on its role in instructional design and assessment

span.label: Its effect on the outcome the paper cares about is explicitly still open.

span.label: The comparison class is characterised rather than measured: existing theories are described as qualitative and subjective, and the description is the ground for replacing them.
span.note: what this limits: the contrast between this quantitative theory and existing ones: the existing theories are characterised as qualitative, subjective and dependent on the educator's skill, rather than compared on a measured outcome

span.label: ChatGPT 3.5's explanation of hubs versus switches omitted the prerequisite (Ethernet), left medium access control, collision domains, dedicated bandwidth and segmentation undefined, and misused 'data packets' and 'broadcast', producing material with high cognitive load and gaps that risk misconceptions.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: On the two sine equations ChatGPT produced a coherent, teachable explanation, but silently mixed degrees in one equation with radians in the other.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Every STEM curriculum item examined across school, college and university level was non-sequential and contained cognitive gaps, i.e. carried a high cognitive load.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Sixty-four business students who had already passed three STEM IT units answered ten simple relational-knowledge questions and every one of them scored zero, indicating their passes carried no relational understanding.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Across school, certificate, diploma, undergraduate and postgraduate STEM teaching, in both face-to-face and remote modes, CLO produced pass and retention rates of typically 100% together with very positive student satisfaction.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Cognitive Load Theory cannot deliver the 'optimized learning' goals because it has no reliable quantitative measure of intrinsic cognitive load, and optimization is by definition a quantitative method.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Ninety-nine percent of the students in the comparison preferred CLO-based learning over the standard method.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: ChatGPT works across STEM disciplines and levels but is an educational technology rather than a learning theory, and gives no assurance of pedagogical quality.
